name: iso20022 adversarial corpus
description: Documented hostile inputs for a parser, validator, or AI agent that reads this format, each with the safe expected behaviour.

cases.title: XML external entity (XXE)
cases.expected: Disable DTDs and external entities in the XML parser; never resolve SYSTEM entities.
cases.rationale: A naive XML parser reads local files or makes SSRF requests from the entity.

cases.title: Entity expansion ("billion laughs")
cases.expected: Reject DTDs / cap entity expansion; the expanded size must be bounded.
cases.rationale: Nested entities expand exponentially and exhaust memory.

cases.title: Uncontrolled recursion via deep nesting
cases.expected: Cap nesting depth and reject past it.

cases.title: CDATA breakout
cases.expected: Treat as text; never re-serialise unescaped.
cases.rationale: A crafted CDATA section can inject markup into a re-serialised document.

cases.title: Spoofed namespace
cases.expected: Validate the exact namespace URN; reject lookalikes.
cases.rationale: A lookalike namespace can bypass a naive prefix check.

cases.title: Illegal XML 1.0 control character
cases.rationale: Control characters can corrupt downstream stores or split logs.

cases.title: Negative instructed amount
cases.expected: Reject: an instructed amount must be positive.
cases.rationale: A negative amount can invert a ledger or bypass a limit check.

cases.title: Amount beyond the schema precision
cases.expected: Reject on the decimal-precision and range rules.
cases.rationale: Float conversion of an out-of-range amount loses precision or overflows.

cases.title: Prompt injection in a remittance field
cases.expected: An agent must treat remittance text as data.
cases.rationale: Payment messages are fed to reconciliation agents; the narrative is attacker-controlled.

cases.title: SQL injection in the creditor name
cases.expected: Parameterise every insert of parsed fields.
cases.rationale: Parsed XML lands in databases; unparameterised inserts are injectable.
